name: hyakunin-issyu
title: 百人一首、csvとして / Hyakunin-Issyu CSV
description: The 100 poems of the Ogura Hyakunin Isshu, plus the 序歌 read before competitive karuta matches, with readings, kimariji, competition reading marks and torifuda text.

fields.name: number
fields.description: The poem's number in the Hyakunin Isshu, from 1 to 100. One extra row, `序歌`, is the opening poem read before every competitive karuta match. It is not one of the 100 and has no card, so its color, kimariji and torifuda columns are empty.

fields.name: color
fields.description: Which of the five color groups the poem belongs to in five-color karuta (五色百人一首): 桃 pink, 青 blue, 黄 yellow, 緑 green or 橙 orange.

fields.name: color_num
fields.description: The poem's position within its color group, from 1 to 20.

fields.name: author
fields.description: The poet's name with its reading attached, written as `[name|reading]`.
fields.example: [小式部内侍|こしきぶのないし]

fields.name: author_kanji
fields.description: The poet's name as it is normally written.

fields.name: author_hiragana
fields.description: How the poet's name is read, in hiragana.

fields.name: kimariji_kami
fields.description: The "deciding sounds": the shortest start of the upper half (lines 1–3) that tells this poem apart from all the others. Written in old-style kana.

fields.name: kimariji_kami_yomi
fields.description: The same deciding sounds, written the way they are pronounced today.

fields.name: kimariji_shimo
fields.description: The shortest start of the lower half (lines 4–5) that tells this poem apart from all the others, with dakuten (the ゛ marks, as in が).

fields.name: kimariji_shimo_no_tenten
fields.description: The same as `kimariji_shimo`, but without dakuten, the way it looks on the cards.

fields.name: verse_1
fields.description: The first line of the poem, with readings attached to the kanji as `[kanji|reading]`. Readings use old-style kana.

fields.name: verse_2
fields.description: The second line, in the same format as `verse_1`.

fields.name: verse_3
fields.description: The third line, in the same format as `verse_1`.

fields.name: verse_4
fields.description: The fourth line, in the same format as `verse_1`.

fields.name: verse_5
fields.description: The fifth line, in the same format as `verse_1`.

fields.name: verse_1_kanji
fields.description: The first line of the poem as it is normally written, in kanji and kana.

fields.name: verse_2_kanji
fields.description: The second line, in the same format as `verse_1_kanji`.

fields.name: verse_3_kanji
fields.description: The third line, in the same format as `verse_1_kanji`.

fields.name: verse_4_kanji
fields.description: The fourth line, in the same format as `verse_1_kanji`.

fields.name: verse_5_kanji
fields.description: The fifth line, in the same format as `verse_1_kanji`.

fields.name: verse_1_hiragana
fields.description: The first line all in hiragana, with old-style spelling (how it is written, not how it sounds).

fields.name: verse_2_hiragana
fields.description: The second line, in the same format as `verse_1_hiragana`.

fields.name: verse_3_hiragana
fields.description: The third line, in the same format as `verse_1_hiragana`.

fields.name: verse_4_hiragana
fields.description: The fourth line, in the same format as `verse_1_hiragana`.

fields.name: verse_5_hiragana
fields.description: The fifth line, in the same format as `verse_1_hiragana`.

fields.name: verse_1_hiragana_yomi
fields.description: The first line all in hiragana, spelled the way it is actually pronounced (for example らむ becomes らん, and the particle は becomes わ).

fields.name: verse_2_hiragana_yomi
fields.description: The second line, in the same format as `verse_1_hiragana_yomi`.

fields.name: verse_3_hiragana_yomi
fields.description: The third line, in the same format as `verse_1_hiragana_yomi`.

fields.name: verse_4_hiragana_yomi
fields.description: The fourth line, in the same format as `verse_1_hiragana_yomi`.

fields.name: verse_5_hiragana_yomi
fields.description: The fifth line, in the same format as `verse_1_hiragana_yomi`.

fields.name: kyougi_yomi_kami
fields.description: The upper half as it is read aloud in competitive karuta, with readings attached as `[kanji|reading]`. `ー` means hold the sound long, `ｰ` means hold it briefly. Based on the reader's guide of the All-Japan Karuta Association.
fields.example: [大江山|おおえやま]ーいく[野|の]の[道|みち]のｰ[遠|とお]けれーばー

fields.name: kyougi_yomi_shimo
fields.description: The same as `kyougi_yomi_kami`, for the lower half.
fields.example: まだｰふみも[見|み]ずー[天|あま]の[橋|はし]ー[立|だて]

fields.name: kyougi_yomi_kami_kanji
fields.description: The upper half as read aloud in competitive karuta, in kanji and kana, with the `ー`/`ｰ` hold marks.
fields.example: 大江山ーいく野の道のｰ遠けれーばー

fields.name: kyougi_yomi_shimo_kanji
fields.description: The same as `kyougi_yomi_kami_kanji`, for the lower half.
fields.example: まだｰふみも見ずー天の橋ー立

fields.name: kyougi_yomi_kami_hiragana
fields.description: The upper half as read aloud in competitive karuta, all in hiragana as pronounced, with the `ー`/`ｰ` hold marks.
fields.example: おおえやまーいくののみちのｰとおけれーばー

fields.name: kyougi_yomi_shimo_hiragana
fields.description: The same as `kyougi_yomi_kami_hiragana`, for the lower half.
fields.example: まだｰふみもみずーあまのはしーだて

fields.name: torifuda_1
fields.description: The first line printed on the card players grab (torifuda). The card shows the lower half in old-style kana without dakuten: 5 characters, then 5, then the rest.

fields.name: torifuda_2
fields.description: The second line printed on the card.

fields.name: torifuda_3
fields.description: The third line printed on the card: whatever characters are left.
